title: Client Partner
description:
**Role: Client Partner - Growth & Business Development**

Location: [Delhi, Bangalore, Mumbai, Pune, Kolkata, Chennai, Hyderabad, Ahmadabad]

Employment Type: Full-Time

Reports To: [Sales Manager]

Experience: 1-3 years

**About the Role:**

We are looking for a motivated Client Partner to join our growing sales team. This is a ground-floor opportunity for someone who wants to build a long-term career in business development and leadership. As a client Partner, you will identify new business opportunities, build strong client relationships, present our services, and convert prospects into long-term customers. High performers will follow a structured growth roadmap toward a State Head leadership role within approximately one year, based on defined performance milestones.

Client Partner roles typically involve new-business development, client relationship management, sales-cycle ownership, and revenue growth.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Identify, contact, and qualify prospective clients through field visits, calls, referrals and digital channels.
* Understand client requirements and recommend suitable products or services.
* Prepare and deliver clear presentations, proposals, and quotations.
* Build trust-based, long-term relationships with clients and decision-makers.
* Achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual revenue targets.

**What We Offer**

* Manage the complete sales cycle: prospecting, follow-up, negotiation, closing, and onboarding.
* Maintain accurate client records, pipeline updates, and sales reports in the CRM.
* Coordinate with internal teams to ensure smooth service delivery and client satisfaction.
* Represent the company professionally in the market and protect its brand reputation.
* Participate in sales reviews, training sessions, and business-planning meetings.
* Market-standard fixed salary, paid on time.
* A clear and transparent incentive structure, explained before joining.
* Family trips and recognition rewards based on target achievement.
* Health insurance coverage for employees, as per company policy.
* Sales training, product training, CRM tools, and continuous coaching.
* A defined career roadmap from Client Partner to Senior Client Partner, Team Lead and State Head.
* A performance-driven culture where achievement is recognized and rewarded.

**Career Growth Roadmap:**

Client Partner → Months 0–3 → Training, market onboarding, pipeline building,

initial closures

Senior Client Partner → Months 4–8 → Consistent target achievement and stronger client

portfolio

Team Lead / Assistant State Head → Months 9–12 → Territory ownership, team support, revenue accountability

State Head → 12+ months → State-level strategy, team leadership, and market

expansion

*Promotion to State Head will be based on achievement of revenue, client-acquisition, consistency, and leadership readiness milestones. \**

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

We are looking for someone who is confident, disciplined, and genuinely interested in building a sales career.

**Education**

* B.Sc. in Computer Science is preferred.
* MBA in Marketing or a related field is preferred.
* Candidates with equivalent qualifications and relevant sales, business development, marketing, or client-facing experience may also apply.

A background in computer science, business, marketing, or a related discipline is commonly preferred for client facing and business-development roles; MBA qualifications are often listed as preferred rather than mandatory.

**Experience**

* 1-3 years of experience in sales, business development, client servicing, marketing, or customer relationship management.
* Prior experience in IT services, software, digital solutions, consulting, or B2B sales will be an added advantage.

**Skills Required**

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong interpersonal, presentation, and negotiation skills.
* Ability to understand client needs and offer suitable solutions.
* Self-motivated, target-oriented, and comfortable with field work.
* Basic knowledge of CRM tools, MS Office, and email communication.
* Willingness to learn about technology-driven products and services.
* Professional appearance, positive attitude, and strong follow-up discipline.

**Success in This Role Looks Like**

* Building a healthy pipeline of qualified prospects.
* Converting leads into paying clients.
* Maintaining strong relationships with existing customers.
* Meeting or exceeding monthly and quarterly targets.
* Growing into a leadership role through consistent performance.

**How to Apply**

**1. Apply Through Our Website**

* Visit www.aasint.com
* Open the Careers section.
* Select the Client Partner job posting.
* Follow the application instructions.

**2. Apply by Email**

* Send your updated CV/resume to hr@aasint.com.
* Subject: Application - Client Partner - [Preferred City]
* Include a short note about your skills and experience.
* Freshers with strong communication skills are welcome.
* Shortlisted candidates will be contacted by HR.

*T&C\*: Preference will be given to candidates who are currently residing in the city for which they are applying.*

Pay: ₹350,000.00 - ₹450,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Flexible schedule
* Food provided
* Health insurance
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund
* Work from home

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Mumbai, Maharashtra

title: Associate Director
description:
**Designation :** **Associate Director**

**Level : L5**

**Location :** **Chennai**

**Experience : 11 to 17 Years**

  
  

**Job Role** :

You will be the senior analytics and AI leader for a set of Technology and Media & Communications clients- the person who owns the client relationship, shapes the analytics and AI roadmap, and makes sure it ships into production and moves a business metric.

Clients in these groups are digital-native and run product telemetry, clickstream, ad-impression and subscriber data at billions of rows, and they buy outcomes (net revenue retention, ARPU, ad yield, cost to serve), not dashboards. The role therefore blends three things: a consulting partner who can hold a VP-level conversation, a data science leader who can review a causal model or an LLM evaluation plan, and a P&L owner who grows the account.

You will also build the practice: reusable accelerators, GenAI and agentic solutions for these industries, and a lead and groom reporting members to run accounts independently.

  
  

**Responsibilities** :

**Client and account leadership**

* Own multiple strategic accounts end to end: relationship, delivery, margin and growth, with Director/VP/CXO stakeholders in product, growth, marketing, revenue operations, finance and similar functions.

* Work with the client & internal teams to build analytics and AI roadmap per account, prioritizing use cases by value, feasibility and data readiness.

* Grow accounts by identifying new problem spaces, writing proposals and SOWs, and converting pilots into multi-year programs.

* Run quarterly business reviews that tie delivered work to client KPIs and documented value.

**Solution design and delivery excellence**

* Translate ambiguous business problems into analytical framings, solution architectures and delivery plans across analytics, data science, ML engineering and data engineering.

* Collaborate with AI CoE and act as technical co-reviewer on model design, experimentation, causal inference, forecasting and GenAI/LLM solutions; challenge assumptions and validate business logic.

* Ensure models reach production with MLOps discipline: versioning, monitoring, drift detection, retraining and documentation.

* Govern delivery health across onsite–offshore teams: scope, estimates, risk, quality gates, utilisation and gross margin.

**GenAI, agentic AI and innovation**

* Support teams in design of GenAI use cases such as conversational analytics, sales and support copilots, content tagging and summarisation, and agentic workflows for marketing and customer operations.

* Set standards for LLM evaluation, guardrails, cost-per-query and responsible AI (privacy, bias, IP and content-rights constraints common in media).

* Partner with hyperscaler and platform alliances (AWS, Azure, GCP, Databricks, Snowflake) on joint solutions and go-to-market as needed.

**Solution building and thought leadership**

* Build reusable accelerators and IP for the industry groups (for example, SaaS churn-and-expansion kit, Media Mix tool kit...).

* Support sales for new logos: discovery workshops, solution demos and orals.

* Publish points of view, speak at industry forums and contribute to analyst briefings.

**People leadership**

* Lead 25–60 people through Managers and Senior Managers; own hiring, staffing, performance calibration and promotions for the portfolio.

* Develop successors who can independently run an account.

* Build a culture of rigour, client focus and continuous learning, including GenAI upskilling.

  

**Required skills** :

10+ years in analytics, data science or AI consulting or a captive analytics/CoE (preferably focused on Tech B2B SaaS or Media & Ent ).

familiarity with at least one cloud (AWS, Azure or GCP) and modern data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery); understanding of MLOps (MLflow, Airflow, CI/CD). • Delivered at least one GenAI/LLM solution beyond proof of concept, including evaluation and guardrails.

**Job Summary**
---------------

**Overview**  
• Actively managing the Bank’s credit portfolio to maximise risk-adjusted returns for sustainable Group RoTE outcomes through better origination discipline, portfolio optimisation, modelling, early identification and action of stressed assets and distribution. Driving balance sheet optimisation and resilience through improving the inter-operability of key subsidiaries, reducing Cost of Funds (CoF) and improving quality and resilience of liabilities by monetising illiquid CIB loans to create medium term secured and contingent funding options that could even be used to raise funds in stress.

**Credit & Portfolio Management (CPM)**  
**Analytics**  
• We do CPM Analytics activities which involve RWA Variance analysis, Account Plan Tracking, CPM MI packs and OBL MI packs. The activities include the production and distribution of RWA Variance reports for CIB, analyzing RWA movements and engaging with GAM’s directly on the reason for the Variance.
  
• Delivers insightful analytics which provide transparency and accountability to facilitate fully informed decisions with the ultimate goal of maximising client revenues and returns.

**Distribution:**  
• CPM Distribution is part of Credit & Portfolio Management. CPM Distribution co-ordinates loan sales in the secondary market to generate liquidity, obtain RWA relief, and offload risk at minimum cost under the guidance of the Origination and Distribution Policy. To facilitate loan sales and other CPM Distribution initiatives, GBS CPM Team extracts the data on all transferable loans from multiple sources and compiles them in the Loan Database.
  
• Distribution also runs various programs that help in the bank offloading RWA. The team functionally supports these various programs.

**SAG Reporting**  
• Monthly, Quarterly, Semi-Annual, and Annual performance of Regulatory and non-Regulatory reports.
  
• Reaching out to in country RM to get clarity / Status of their clients.
  
• Reaching out the Account manager and Account owners for Clarity on SAG accounts.

------------------------

**Strategy**

• Help to look for possibilities of leveraging on synergy within the various processes through automation thereby bringing in improvements.

title: Marketing Executive
description:
About Arkahub

Arkahub (Interglacial Renewable Technologies Pvt. Ltd.) is building the infrastructure for residential solar in India. We make rooftop solar adoption simple and seamless for homeowners—from consultation and design to installation and after-sales support.

With a strong presence in Bengaluru and Hyderabad, we are expanding and looking for a highly driven Marketing Executive to lead our on-ground customer acquisition initiatives.

Work Location: Pune

About the Role

As a Marketing Executive, you will be responsible for creating and executing local, on-ground marketing initiatives that generate qualified customer leads for our Sales team. You will build strong relationships with Resident Welfare Associations (RWAs), apartment communities, local influencers, and key ecosystem partners to establish Arkahub's presence across Bangalore , Hyderabad , Pune , Nagpur ,Chennai

This is also a field role that requires excellent communication, relationship-building skills, and the ability to execute marketing campaigns independently.

Key Responsibilities

Community & RWA Partnerships

* Identify and build relationships with Resident Welfare Associations (RWAs), apartment associations, gated communities, and housing societies.
* Schedule and conduct meetings with RWA committees to introduce Arkahub's residential solar solutions.
* Secure permissions for awareness sessions, society activations, kiosks, and customer engagement events.
* Develop long-term partnerships with communities to create a recurring pipeline of customer leads

Lead Generation & Field Marketing

* Plan and execute Door-to-Door (D2D) outreach campaigns across targeted residential areas.
* Organize and manage Below-the-Line (BTL) marketing activities such as:
* Society activations
* Residential stalls and kiosks
* Community awareness drives
* Weekend events
* Local exhibitions and campaigns
* Educate homeowners about rooftop solar, financing options, and the benefits of switching to solar.
* Generate qualified customer leads and ensure they are accurately captured in the CRM.

DISCOM & Local Ecosystem Coordination

* Build and maintain relationships with local DISCOM officials and other relevant stakeholders to support lead generation opportunities.
* Coordinate with local ecosystem partners wherever applicable to improve market visibility and customer acquisition.
* Identify local events, associations, and networking opportunities that can help expand Arkahub's presence.

Sales Coordination

* Work closely with the Presales team to qualify leads and schedule customer meetings.
* Coordinate with Sales Consultants to ensure timely customer visits and follow-ups.
* Track lead status and help improve conversion through continuous coordination between field marketing and sales teams.

Campaign Execution & Reporting

* Execute city-level marketing campaigns as per business priorities.
* Share market insights, customer feedback, and competitor activities with the leadership team.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Commerce, or any related field.
* 2–5 years of experience in field marketing, BTL marketing, sales, community engagement, or business development.
* Experience working with residential communities, RWAs, channel partners, or local institutions is highly preferred.
* Strong communication, negotiation, and relationship management skills.
* Comfortable with extensive field travel within Pune .
* Ability to work independently in a fast-paced startup environment.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, Google Sheets, and CRM tools is an advantage.
* Fluency in English, Hindi, and Marathi is preferred.
* The candidate must have a two Wheeler and a valid driving license

Why Join Arkahub?

* Be part of one of India's fastest-growing startups.
* Work directly with experienced founders and business leaders.
* Build a city from the ground up and make a visible business impact.
* Opportunity to grow into Marketing, Growth, or Business Development leadership roles as the company expands.
* Competitive compensation and a high-ownership work environment where your ideas and execution matter.

**Why choose AstraZeneca India?**
---------------------------------

Help push the boundaries of science to deliver life-changing medicines to patients. After 45 years in India, we’re continuing to secure a future where everyone can access affordable, sustainable, innovative healthcare.

The part you play in our business will be challenging, yet rewarding, requiring you to use your resilient, collaborative and diplomatic skillsets to make connections. -----------------------

Calling all tech innovators, ownership takers, challenge seekers and proactive collaborators. At AstraZeneca, breakthroughs born in the lab become transformative medicine for the world's most complex diseases. We empower people like you to push the boundaries of science, challenge convention, and unleash your entrepreneurial spirit. You'll embrace differences and take bold actions to drive the change needed to meet global healthcare and sustainability challenges.

Here, diverse minds and bold disruptors can meaningfully impact the future of healthcare using cutting-edge technology. Whether you join us in Bengaluru or Chennai, you can make a tangible impact within a global biopharmaceutical company that invests in your future. Join a talented global team that's powering AstraZeneca to better serve patients every day.

**Success Profile**
-------------------

Ready to make an impact in your career? If you're passionate, growth-orientated and a true team player, we'll help you succeed. Here are some of the skills and capabilities we look for.

### **Tech innovators**

Make a greater impact through our digitally enabled enterprise. Use your skills in data and technology to transform and optimise our operations, helping us deliver meaningful work that changes lives.

### **Ownership takers**

If you're a self-aware self-starter who craves autonomy, AstraZeneca provides the perfect environment to take ownership and grow. Here, you'll feel empowered to lead and reach excellence at every level — with unrivalled support when you need it.

### **Challenge seekers**

Adapting and advancing our progress means constantly challenging the status quo. In this dynamic environment where everything we do has urgency and focus, you'll have the ability to show up, speak up and confidently take smart risks.

### **Proactive collaborators**

Your unique perspectives make our ambitions and capabilities possible. Our culture of sharing ideas, learning and improving together helps us consistently set the bar higher. As a proactive collaborator, you'll seek out ways to bring people together to achieve their best.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

**Job ID** R-262639 **Date posted** 10/25/2026

**GCL : D1**
------------

**Introduction to role:**
-------------------------

Are you ready to turn complex data into clear, confident decisions that shape the future of life-changing medicines? In this role, you will develop patient, volume, and revenue forecasts for strategic brands and early assets across Global priority markets and the US—work that directly informs brand strategy, investment decisions, and how we reach patients faster!

Based at Manyata Tech Park, Bangalore on a hybrid schedule (three days a week in office) with a 2 PM - 11 PM IST shift, you will partner closely with forecasting leadership and Commercial teams. You will build and own models that set performance expectations, provide clarity on risk and opportunity, and guide cross-functional teams toward decisive action. Do you thrive in a dynamic environment where your analysis sparks strategy and your point of view earns trust?

**Accountabilities:**
---------------------

* Develop and own forecast models. Build, validate, and maintain strong short-term and long-term models. These models reflect current data, assumptions, and market dynamics for key brands and initial assets.
* Decision Support: Translate insights into clear recommendations, expertly defend methodologies and assumptions, and influence cross-functional collaborators with clear logic and quantified confidence.
* Cross-Functional Alignment: Align forecast assumptions and analytical outputs with partners in Marketing, Sales, Market Access and Pricing, Finance, Analytics, and Sales Operations to ensure a single, trusted view of demand.
* New Product Introduction: Develop volume forecasts for launches to feed strategic and operational planning, informing resourcing, supply, and market activation.
* Data and Methodology Difficulty: Identify and apply the right data sources and industry-leading approaches; integrate primary research and secondary data to ensure objectivity and comprehensive coverage.
* Sensitivity and Scenario Analysis: Conduct simulations and ranges (including Monte Carlo as appropriate) to clarify uncertainty, quantify upside/downside, and support risk management.
* Global Pipeline and Early Assets: Create new forecast frameworks as business needs emerge for pipeline assets, lifecycle management, and business development opportunities.
* US Planning Cadence: For US-focused work, participate in S&OP processes, submit volumes, and build weekly, monthly, and annual models and conversions aligned to commercial rhythms.
* Continuous Improvement: Evolve forecasting capabilities through innovation in methodologies, automation, and tools; champion standard processes that improve speed, reliability, and decision quality.
* Documentation and Communication: Deliver forecasts with clear, accessible documentation of assumptions, confidence levels, and key drivers; proactively surface issues that matter to the business.

**Essential Skills/Experience:**
--------------------------------

* Bachelor’s Degree in relevant field
* 6+ years of direct Pharmaceutical forecasting experience with an in-depth knowledge of forecasting techniques, models and approaches
* Good understanding of multiple disease areas, with experience in rare diseases/ OBU including how patients move through their respective diagnosis and treatment pathways, including treatment dynamics
* Experience integrating insights from market research and secondary data analysis into forecast assumptions
* Experience using a range of data sources and analytics involving standard data in the Pharmaceutical industry – e.g. IQVIA (MIDAS, DDD NPA, Monthly Xponent), claims data (Truven, Marketscan), epidemiological data, etc. For US forecasting, experience with TRx / NBRx / NRx data and methodologies
* Strong analytical expertise; excellent Excel, financial modelling and forecasting skills
* Ability to build trusted relationships across a range of partner groups including Marketing, Analytics, Operations, and Technology
* Confirmed experience in problem solving and continuous improvement
* Strong written and verbal communication

**Desirable Skills/Experience:**
--------------------------------

* Advanced degree or equivalent experience preferred (e.g., PhD, MBA, Masters)
* Knowledge and experience in sophisticated statistical forecast methodologies and applied AI / ML / automation
* Experience working with Power Apps, specifically PowerBI
* For US forecasting, confirmed understanding of US Market Access and gross-to-net

--------------------

Join a high-performing, digitally savvy community where bold thinking is encouraged and supported. * Scale operational delivery: Set priorities and govern service quality, capacity, risk, financial health, resilience, and continuous transformation; act as the senior escalation point when outcomes are at risk.

**AI-Enabled Transformation & Performance**

* Set a value-led AI and automation agenda: Prioritize analytics, automation, GenAI, and agentic use cases across intake, workflow, content, quality assurance, campaign operations, reporting, optimization, and knowledge management.

* Scale innovation into live operations: Sponsor initiatives from business case through production, adoption, and benefits realization; redesign processes, roles, skills, controls, KPIs, staffing, and commercial assumptions as work changes.

* Govern trust and performance: Establish responsible AI, data, privacy, security, intellectual property, and human-oversight guardrails, with scorecards covering marketing outcomes, SLAs, quality, productivity, innovation, financials, and risk.

**Enterprise & Talent Leadership**

* Lead through leaders: Build the organization and leadership system, clarify accountabilities, align multidisciplinary teams, coach senior leaders, and create succession depth.

* Build a differentiated talent model: Combine marketing craft, platform expertise, operational rigor, consulting capability, and AI fluency; mobilize consulting, creative, media, technology, data, finance, risk, talent, and alliance teams around a shared direction.

**Location:** Hyderabad / Chennai

**Education:** Bachelor’s degree required; postgraduate qualification or MBA preferred.

* Senior leadership experience: 16+ years of professional experience, including at least 10 years leading large-scale marketing operations, agency delivery, digital operations, or managed services and a minimum of 5 years in executive leadership roles.

* Proven build-and-scale track record: Demonstrated experience setting up, transitioning, stabilizing, and scaling global or enterprise operations, including organizations of approximately 300–1,000+ team members.

* Deep marketing operations credibility: Strong operational understanding across multiple marketing domains such as campaign and media operations, CRM and lifecycle marketing, creative and content supply chain, MarTech operations, customer journey orchestration, data, analytics, and measurement.

* AI and automation leadership: Evidence of identifying, sponsoring, and scaling automation, analytics, GenAI, or agentic initiatives within live operations, with responsibility for adoption, controls, operating-model change, and measurable benefits—not only pilots or technology implementation.

* Commercial and P&L ownership: Experience owning a multi-million-dollar portfolio or P&L and making decisions across growth, pricing, investment, margin, capacity, utilization, and risk.

* Global delivery and transformation: Experience leading distributed onshore, nearshore, and offshore models and large transformation programs across multiple clients, geographies, or service towers.

* Executive client leadership: Credibility with senior marketing, customer, digital, technology, operations, and procurement stakeholders and the ability to influence strategic decisions in complex client environments.

* Thought leadership and market orientation: A clear point of view on the evolution of marketing operations, agency models, platforms, data, AI, and managed services, with the ability to convert that perspective into propositions and client conversations.

* Leadership judgment: Strong analytical, commercial, organizational, negotiation, and influencing skills, with the ability to make timely decisions, manage ambiguity, and provide calm direction during high-stakes delivery situations.

As a multidisciplinary group of strategists, designers, engineers, data specialists, and operators, we connect the work of transformation with the discipline of ongoing operations. **Hiring: O&M Manager – Water & Wastewater Treatment Plants**

**Location:** Chennai, Tamil Nadu

**About the Role**

We are looking for an experienced and technically proficient **Operations & Maintenance (O&M) Manager** to manage and oversee water and wastewater treatment facilities, including STP, ETP, WTP, RO, ATFD, MEE, MVR, and Boiler systems.

The ideal candidate should have strong technical knowledge, proven experience in plant operations and maintenance, team management capabilities, client-handling skills, and the ability to optimize plant performance while ensuring safety, quality, and environmental compliance.

The candidate will also support technical proposals, business development activities, and operational improvement initiatives across multiple project locations in India.

**Key Technical Competencies**

The candidate must possess sound working knowledge and hands-on experience in the operation, maintenance, troubleshooting, and performance optimization of the following systems:

**STP – Sewage Treatment Plant:** Treatment processes, biological systems, sludge management, equipment maintenance, and treated water quality.

**ETP – Effluent Treatment Plant:** Industrial wastewater treatment, chemical dosing, process control, effluent quality monitoring, and statutory compliance.

**WTP – Water Treatment Plant:** Clarification, filtration, softening, disinfection, and water quality management.

**RO – Reverse Osmosis Systems:** Membrane operations, pretreatment, CIP, recovery optimization, and troubleshooting.

**ATFD – Agitated Thin Film Dryer:** Drying operations, thermal performance, product handling, and equipment maintenance.

**MEE – Multiple Effect Evaporator:** Evaporation processes, steam consumption optimization, scaling control, and condensate management.

**MVR – Mechanical Vapor Recompression:** Vapor recompression systems, energy efficiency, process control, and operational troubleshooting.

**Boilers:** Boiler operations, preventive maintenance, combustion efficiency, water treatment, safety systems, and statutory requirements.

**Roles and Responsibilities**

* **Operations & Maintenance Management**

Manage end-to-end O&M activities across water and wastewater treatment plants.

Ensure smooth plant operations, equipment reliability, process stability, and achievement of performance targets.

Implement preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance programs.

Monitor plant performance, energy consumption, chemical usage, water recovery, and operating costs.

* **Technical Troubleshooting and Optimization**

Identify and resolve operational, mechanical, electrical, and process-related issues in coordination with relevant technical teams.

Analyze plant performance data and implement corrective and preventive actions.

Improve plant efficiency, reduce downtime, and optimize resource utilization.

Ensure compliance with client-specific process parameters and treatment quality requirements.

* **Manpower Planning and Team Leadership**

Plan manpower requirements and deploy personnel across project sites.

Lead and supervise engineers, supervisors, technicians, and plant operators.

Conduct technical training, performance reviews, and safety awareness sessions.

Ensure effective shift management, work allocation, and workforce productivity.

* **Client Management and Coordination**

Maintain effective communication and professional relationships with clients.

Attend technical meetings, review plant performance, and address operational concerns.

Coordinate with project, engineering, procurement, service, and management teams.

Ensure timely resolution of client complaints and achievement of agreed service levels.

* **Technical Proposals and Business Development Support**

Assist in preparing technical and commercial proposals for O&M contracts and water/wastewater treatment projects.

Review technical specifications, process requirements, scope of work, and operating costs.

Support technical presentations, client discussions, site assessments, and tender submissions.

Provide technical inputs to the marketing and business development teams.

* **Safety, Quality, and Environmental Compliance**

Ensure adherence to applicable safety procedures, environmental regulations, and statutory requirements.

Implement safe operating practices, risk assessments, and emergency response procedures.

Monitor treatment quality, operational records, maintenance logs, and compliance documentation.

Promote a culture of safety, accountability, and continuous improvement.

* **Reporting and Performance Monitoring**

Prepare periodic operational, maintenance, manpower, and performance reports.

Monitor KPIs, plant availability, downtime, operating expenditure, and service quality.

Identify opportunities for cost reduction and process improvement.

Ensure proper documentation and reporting to senior management and clients.

**Required Skills and Competencies**

Strong technical understanding of water and wastewater treatment technologies.

Proven experience in managing plant operations, maintenance, and troubleshooting.

Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

Strong leadership, manpower management, and decision-making abilities.

Good client relationship management and coordination skills.

Ability to prepare technical proposals and support business development.

Strong analytical, problem-solving, and operational planning skills.

Knowledge of EHS practices, environmental standards, and relevant statutory compliance.

Willingness to travel extensively or relocate anywhere in India based on project requirements.

**Educational Qualifications**

B.E. / B.Tech in Chemical, Mechanical, Environmental, Civil, or a relevant engineering discipline.

Diploma in a relevant technical or engineering discipline.

Science Graduate with substantial relevant industry experience.

**Experience Requirements**

Minimum 10 years of relevant industry experience in water and wastewater treatment plant operations and maintenance.

Experience in handling multiple treatment technologies and managing teams across project sites will be an advantage.

Candidates with experience in industrial wastewater treatment, ZLD systems, evaporation and drying technologies, RO plants, and boiler operations are encouraged to apply.

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

Experienced O&M professional with strong technical and managerial capabilities.

Capable of independently managing plant operations and client expectations.

Comfortable working across different industrial sectors and project locations.

Commercially aware, service-oriented, and focused on plant performance and cost optimization.

Available to join immediately or at short notice.

Interested candidates who meet the above requirements are invited to share their updated resume, highlighting relevant plant experience, technical expertise, current CTC, expected CTC, notice period, and willingness to travel or relocate across India.

title: E-Commerce Manager
description:
We're Hiring: E-commerce Manager – Wizzowl Jewellery

**Company:** Wizzowl Jewellery  
**Location:** Chennai, Tamil Nadu  
**Employment Type:** Full-time  
**Experience:** 3–5 years  
**Salary:** ₹35,000–₹55,000 per month, depending on experience and capability  
**Industry:** D2C E-commerce | Silver Jewellery | Fashion & Lifestyle

About Wizzowl

Wizzowl is a contemporary silver jewellery brand creating jewellery for everyday life. Our collections include silver nose pins, nose rings, earrings, ear cuffs, toe rings, chains and other everyday jewellery.

We are strengthening our e-commerce business and rebuilding the customer experience to create a scalable, profitable D2C brand. We are looking for a hands-on E-commerce Manager who can take ownership of our online store, improve conversion rates, increase revenue and build efficient systems for sustainable growth.

Role Overview

As E-commerce Manager, you will be responsible for the overall performance and growth of Wizzowl's online business. You will manage our Shopify store, improve the customer journey, coordinate digital acquisition, optimise product merchandising, monitor business performance and build retention strategies.

We are looking for someone who understands the commercial side of e-commerce: **revenue, conversion, average order value, customer acquisition cost, repeat purchases and profitability.**

Key Responsibilities1. Shopify Store Management

* Manage and continuously improve the Wizzowl Shopify website.
* Own product listings, collections, navigation, merchandising, pricing and promotions.
* Coordinate product launches, landing pages, campaign pages and seasonal collections.
* Improve mobile shopping experience, site speed, checkout flow and product discovery.
* Work with developers and apps to resolve technical issues and improve store functionality.
* Maintain product information, images, descriptions, FAQs, trust elements and jewellery authenticity details.

2. Online Revenue and Conversion Growth

* Develop and execute plans to grow website revenue and order volume.
* Analyse the customer journey from product discovery to purchase.
* Identify and fix conversion bottlenecks across product pages, cart and checkout.
* Improve add-to-cart rate, checkout completion, average order value and overall conversion rate.
* Test bundles, cross-sells, upsells, offers and merchandising strategies.
* Track sales, discounts, returns, cancellations and contribution to profitability.

3. Performance Marketing Coordination

* Work closely with internal teams, freelancers or agencies managing Meta and Google Ads.
* Monitor traffic quality, conversion performance, customer acquisition cost and return on ad spend.
* Connect campaign performance with actual Shopify revenue and profitability.
* Coordinate creative requirements, landing pages, product feeds and campaign promotions.
* Identify underperforming campaigns and recommend actionable improvements.
* Ensure tracking, pixels, conversion events and reporting are functioning correctly.

**Note:** This is a business ownership role, not just an ad-reporting role. Candidates who can independently manage paid advertising are preferred, but the manager must at least be capable of analysing performance and holding agencies accountable.

4. SEO and Organic Growth

* Coordinate technical SEO, product and collection page optimisation.
* Improve category architecture, internal linking, metadata and product content.
* Work on organic visibility for relevant keywords, including silver nose pins and silver mookuthi.
* Coordinate blogs, buying guides and other useful search-focused content.
* Monitor organic traffic, search rankings and revenue from organic channels.
* Support recovery and growth of Wizzowl's organic search presence.

5. Customer Retention and CRM

* Develop WhatsApp, email and other retention campaigns.
* Plan abandoned-cart, browse-abandonment, post-purchase and repeat-purchase flows.
* Work on customer segmentation, reactivation, loyalty and referral initiatives.
* Analyse repeat purchase rates and customer lifetime value.
* Coordinate promotional campaigns without over-relying on discounts.

6. Product and Inventory Coordination

* Work with the product and operations teams to maintain accurate online inventory.
* Plan product launches and prioritise collections based on demand and sales performance.
* Monitor bestsellers, slow-moving products, stockouts and return patterns.
* Coordinate with the manufacturing and supply team to improve product availability.
* Maintain accurate product information and consistency across the website and marketing channels.

7. Analytics and Reporting

* Maintain a clear weekly and monthly e-commerce performance dashboard.
* Track revenue, orders, sessions, conversion rate, AOV, CAC, ROAS, repeat purchases and returns.
* Analyse performance by product, category, campaign and traffic source.
* Identify growth opportunities using data rather than assumptions.
* Present a clear action plan covering what worked, what did not and what should happen next.

Required Skills and Experience

* 3–5 years of experience in e-commerce, preferably with a D2C brand.
* Hands-on experience managing Shopify or a comparable e-commerce platform.
* Strong understanding of e-commerce conversion, merchandising and online revenue growth.
* Working knowledge of Meta Ads, Google Ads, GA4 and conversion tracking.
* Understanding of SEO, CRM, WhatsApp marketing and retention campaigns.
* Strong analytical skills and proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets.
* Experience with product catalogues, promotions, inventory coordination and order workflows.
* Ability to work independently, prioritise tasks and execute improvements without constant supervision.
* Strong communication, ownership and problem-solving skills.

Experience in jewellery, fashion, accessories, beauty or lifestyle D2C brands will be an advantage.

Performance Metrics (KPIs)

The E-commerce Manager will be evaluated on:

* Online revenue and month-on-month growth.
* Website conversion rate and checkout completion.
* Average order value and revenue per session.
* Customer acquisition cost and marketing efficiency.
* Repeat purchase rate and customer retention.
* Organic traffic and organic revenue growth.
* Product availability, merchandising accuracy and website experience.
* Profitability and the quality of reporting and execution.

Targets will be established after reviewing the current business baseline and available marketing budget.

Who Should Apply?

We are looking for a practical, commercially minded professional who enjoys building systems, solving problems and growing an online business.

You should be comfortable working in a growing company where you will have direct ownership, quick decision-making and the opportunity to influence the business.

Candidates who only coordinate tasks or prepare reports without taking ownership of results may not be the right fit.

How to Apply

Please share your resume along with a brief note covering:

* The D2C or e-commerce brands you have managed.
* The approximate monthly online revenue you have handled.
* One measurable improvement you achieved in revenue, conversion or marketing efficiency.
* Your experience with Shopify, Meta Ads, Google Ads, SEO and CRM.

**Join Wizzowl and help build a stronger, more scalable D2C jewellery brand.**

Make a greater impact through our digitally enabled enterprise. Use your skills in data and technology to transform and optimise our operations, helping us deliver meaningful work that changes lives.

Adapting and advancing our progress means constantly challenging the status quo. In this dynamic environment where everything we do has urgency and focus, you'll have the ability to show up, speak up and confidently take smart risks.

Your unique perspectives make our ambitions and capabilities possible. Our culture of sharing ideas, learning and improving together helps us consistently set the bar higher. As a proactive collaborator, you'll seek out ways to bring people together to achieve their best.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

**Job ID** R-262147 **Date posted** 10/19/2026

**GCL: C2**
-----------

Introduction to role:

Are you ready to turn real-time social conversation into decisions that accelerate our impact for patients and the business? As a Social Media Listening Associate/Analyst in Chennai, you will convert signals from global and local channels into clear, timely insights that guide content, media, and engagement decisions across our portfolio. Your analysis will help teams understand sentiment, surface emerging topics, and act quickly to improve how we communicate.

You will join a fast paced analytics capability that partners closely with brand, communications, media, and digital teams. We move from question to answer in days, not months—designing queries, validating data, and delivering concise stories that change decisions. You will be trusted to run with complex datasets, speak up with recommendations, and that teams can act on this week?

**Accountabilities:**
---------------------

Topic and Taxonomy Design: Support the definition of topics, measures, and filters to frame clear objectives and deliverables for both standard and custom reports.

Query Engineering and Tool Setup: Build and refine social listening queries, keywords, and parameters; configure dashboards to ensure accurate capture of volume, sentiment, drivers, and influencers.

Data Quality and Refinement: Take ownership of query iteration to reduce noise and bias, ensuring precise, decision-ready mention analysis by the close of each reporting period.

Insight Generation and Storytelling: Pull, interpret, and synthesize data into sharp insights that inform content and media decisions for campaigns and events; advise teams on optimizations and next actions.

Reporting and Visualization: Create clear, visually compelling deliverables in PowerPoint, newsletters, and Excel—using charts, tables, and infographics to turn data into a coherent narrative.

Campaign Optimization Partner: Translate findings into practical recommendations that impact targeting, creative, and channel mix; track outcomes and iterate to improve results.

Standards and Compliance: Operate within global social listening SOPs and compliance policies; uphold data integrity and ethical standards at all times.

Collaboration and Communication: Work closely with cross-functional partners to align on objectives, share findings succinctly, and influence decisions with evidence.

**Essential Skills/Experience:**
--------------------------------

* 2-4 years of experience
* Social Media Listening
* Bachelor’s Degree in any stream/Pharma or Mpharm (Pharmocology is preferred) or MBA
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills and proven ability to transform data into a concise, yet compelling story.
* Ability to synthesize information and produce insightful and accurate analysis and recommendations.
* Highly organized and impeccable attention to detail. Able to handle multiple projects simultaneously and deliver accurate reports without grammatical or data errors.
* Strong sense of responsibility, takes ownership, self-starter and proactive attitude.
* Good Mix of Technical Understanding, Business Sense, Managerial/Connecting and Interpersonal skills
* Strong familiarity and understanding of social media platforms (preferred) such as Facebook, Twitter, Blogs, Forums, Instagram and Tumblr required.
* Comfortable with MS Office Suite including Excel, PowerPoint.
* Exp in any Social Listening tools such as - Sprinklr, BrandWatch, Talkwalker, Meltwater, Netbase, Social Studio.

**Desirable Skills/Experience:**
--------------------------------

* Pharmaceutical and social listening experience is good to have
* Hands-on experience configuring queries, dashboards, and reports in enterprise social listening platforms
* Experience turning monitoring outputs into campaign or content optimizations within regulated environments
* Familiarity with global SOPs and compliance considerations for digital and social data

Here, your curiosity and drive meet real-world impact. You will be part of a global, fast-evolving community that uses data to make better decisions—putting unexpected teams in the same room to unleash bold thinking and move quickly from insight to action. We value kindness alongside ambition, trust you to take ownership, and back you with a strong network that shares, learns, and builds together. title: Executive to the Chairman – Special Projects, Business Execution & Transformation
description:
Executive to the Chairman – Special Projects, Business Execution &

Transformation

Company: Spartek Group

Location: Chennai, Tamil Nadu

qualification is an added advantage.

About Spartek Group

Spartek Group is a diversified business group with a legacy spanning over four

decades, with interests across building materials, ceramics, sanitaryware,

precast concrete solutions, industrial and decorative flooring, construction

chemicals, and consumer tableware.

Through its various businesses and brands, including Spartek Tiles, Neycer

Sanitaryware, Spartekoncrete and UNIFORT, the Group is focused on

expanding its market presence, strengthening manufacturing and operational

capabilities, developing new business opportunities, and adopting technology-

driven solutions to improve business performance.

As the Group continues to pursue new growth opportunities and business

transformation initiatives, it offers an entrepreneurial environment for

professionals who are keen to work closely with senior leadership, take

ownership of challenging assignments, and contribute directly to business

growth.

About the Role

Spartek Group is looking for a dynamic, entrepreneurial and execution-

oriented professional to work directly with the Chairman on strategic

initiatives, special projects, business development, operational improvements

and organisational transformation.

This is a high-ownership, cross-functional role that provides exposure to

multiple business verticals, including manufacturing, sales and marketing,

finance, human resources, technology, digital transformation and new

business development.

1The individual will be responsible for converting the Chairman’s priorities and

business ideas into actionable plans and ensuring their successful

implementation. The role requires someone who is equally comfortable

analysing business opportunities, coordinating with senior management,

visiting manufacturing facilities, working with frontline teams and personally

driving projects to completion.

This is not a conventional desk-based corporate strategy role. We are looking

for someone who can move beyond planning and presentations to deliver

tangible, measurable business outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

* Chairman’s Special Projects: Drive priority assignments, new initiatives

and strategic projects from conception through implementation and

closure.

* Business Development: Evaluate new products, markets, customer

segments and business opportunities; support commercial proposals,

market research and business launches.

* Manufacturing and Operations: Identify opportunities to improve

productivity, quality, cost efficiency, inventory management,

procurement and operational processes.

* Finance and Commercial Analysis: Support budgeting, cost monitoring,

working capital improvements, financial reporting and business

performance analysis.

* Technology and AI: Identify and implement practical applications of AI,

automation, ERP, CRM, dashboards and digital tools to improve

productivity and decision-making.

* Cross-Functional Coordination: Work closely with business heads, plant

teams, sales, finance, HR, IT, procurement and external stakeholders to

ensure timely execution.

* Project Monitoring: Establish milestones, timelines, budgets,

performance indicators and progress reports to monitor implementation

and results.

* Organisational Improvement: Support recruitment, performance

measurement, process standardisation, accountability and change

management initiatives.

2Candidate Profile

* 3–5 years of relevant experience in project execution, business

operations, business development, manufacturing, consulting with

hands-on implementation, or business transformation.

* Engineering degree preferred, particularly in Mechanical, Industrial,

Civil, Electrical or related disciplines.

* MBA or a management qualification in Operations, Finance, Strategy,

Marketing or General Management is an added advantage.

* Experience in building materials, manufacturing, consumer products,

homeware, FMCG, distribution or allied industries is desirable.

* Strong analytical, commercial and problem-solving skills.

* Good working knowledge of Excel, PowerPoint, project management

tools and business reporting.

* Practical familiarity with AI tools, automation and digital applications.

* Excellent communication, stakeholder management and coordination

skills.

* Willingness to travel to factories, warehouses, customer locations and

other Group offices as required.

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for a professional with an entrepreneurial mindset, a strong

sense of ownership, a bias for action and the ability to work independently in a

fast-paced business environment.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable working with ambiguity, learning

unfamiliar business processes, solving ground-level problems and taking

responsibility for outcomes.

Candidates who have personally implemented projects and delivered

measurable results will be preferred over those whose experience is primarily

limited to analysis, presentations or recommendations.

Career Development

This role offers direct exposure to the Chairman and the opportunity to

understand and contribute to multiple businesses within Spartek Group.

Based on demonstrated performance, the individual may progress into roles

such as Special Projects Manager, Business Operations or Transformation

3Manager, New Business Initiative Lead, or Business Development/Operations

Head for a business unit.

The position is particularly suited to professionals who aspire to develop into

future business leaders by combining analytical ability, commercial

understanding, technology orientation and hands-on execution.

Application Process

Interested candidates are requested to share their updated CV along with brief

details of two or three projects or initiatives they have personally

implemented. Applications should highlight the candidate’s individual

contribution, challenges addressed and measurable outcomes achieved.

If you are someone who takes ownership, enjoys solving real business

problems and wants to build businesses rather than simply manage tasks, we

would like to hear from you.

Pay: ₹55,000.00 - ₹65,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

What We’re Looking For

* GTM Preview Mode

* Identify potential customers and business opportunities in residential, commercial, industrial, and institutional sectors.

* Prepare and share quotations and service proposals with customers.
* Conduct regular follow-ups on enquiries and quotations.
* Convert qualified leads into confirmed business.
* Achieve assigned monthly sales and revenue targets.
* Develop new customer accounts and maintain a healthy sales pipeline.

2. Marketing Activities

* Conduct field marketing activities in assigned areas.
* Promote company services to potential customers and business establishments.
* Identify new market segments and opportunities for business growth.
* Develop contacts with apartments, offices, factories, warehouses, hotels, restaurants, schools, hospitals, retail establishments, and other potential clients.
* Support promotional campaigns and other marketing initiatives.
* Participate in exhibitions, networking activities, campaigns, and business-development events when required.
* Represent the company professionally during all customer interactions.

3. Customer Relationship Management

* Build and maintain professional relationships with prospective and existing customers.
* Understand customer concerns and provide appropriate assistance and coordination.
* Follow up with existing customers for repeat services, renewals, AMC/MOU opportunities, and additional service requirements.
* Collect customer feedback and communicate relevant requirements to the operations team.
* Ensure customers receive timely responses to enquiries and quotations.
* Maintain a professional and customer-focused approach at all times.

4. Quotation & Follow-Up Management

* Collect accurate information required for preparing quotations.
* Coordinate with the technical and operations teams whenever necessary.
* Ensure quotations and proposals are prepared and submitted on time.
* Maintain regular follow-ups with customers.
* Update the status of leads, enquiries, quotations, and sales opportunities.
* Negotiate with customers within the pricing and approval guidelines of the company.
* Coordinate internally after receiving confirmation from the customer.

5. Reporting & Documentation

* Maintain records of all leads, customer meetings, enquiries, quotations, follow-ups, and conversions.
* Submit daily, weekly, or monthly activity reports as required by management.
* Update the sales pipeline regularly.
* Provide accurate information regarding pending quotations and follow-ups.
* Maintain proper customer and business-development records.
* Follow the company's reporting procedures and instructions.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The employee's performance may be evaluated based on:

* Achievement of assigned sales and revenue targets.
* Number and quality of new leads generated.
* Number of customer calls, meetings, and field visits.
* Number of quotations submitted.
* Follow-up effectiveness.
* Lead-to-customer conversion rate.
* New customer acquisition.
* AMC/MOU sales and renewals.
* Repeat business and customer retention.
* Accuracy and timely submission of reports.
* Professional conduct and adherence to company procedures.

Required Skills

* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strong sales, marketing, and negotiation abilities.
* Good customer-handling skills.
* Ability to generate leads and develop new business.
* Strong follow-up and relationship-management skills.
* Ability to understand and explain pest management services.
* Basic knowledge of MS Office, email, WhatsApp, and other business communication tools.
* Ability to prepare and explain quotations and proposals.
* Good planning and time-management skills.
* Ability to work independently as well as part of a team.
* Willingness to travel for field visits and customer meetings.
* Ability to work in a target-oriented environment.

Qualification & Experience

* Any Graduate / Equivalent qualification.
* Experience in Sales, Marketing, Business Development, Facility Management, or Pest Management will be an advantage.
* Freshers with good communication skills, confidence, and interest in sales and marketing may also be considered.

Personal Attributes

The ideal candidate should be:

* Self-motivated and energetic.
* Target-oriented and result-focused.
* Confident and professional.
* Presentable while meeting customers.
* Proactive in identifying new business opportunities.
* Responsible and disciplined.
* Willing to learn about pest management services.
* Capable of handling customer interactions professionally.
* Able to take initiative and contribute towards company growth.

PROBATION PERIODDuration

The selected candidate will be on a **probation period of 3 months** from the date of joining.

Performance Evaluation

During the probation period, the employee's overall performance will be evaluated based on:

* Attendance and punctuality.
* Professional behaviour and conduct.
* Communication and customer-handling skills.
* Understanding of the company's services and sales process.
* Field-sales and marketing activities.
* Lead generation and business-development efforts.
* Customer meetings and site visits.
* Quotation preparation and follow-up.
* Sales performance and achievement of assigned targets.
* Timely submission of reports.
* Compliance with company policies, procedures, and instructions.

Training & Support

During the probation period, the company may provide training and guidance to help the employee understand:

* Pest management services and service packages.
* Common pest problems and basic service solutions.
* Customer enquiry-handling procedures.
* Field-sales and marketing processes.
* Lead generation and follow-up methods.
* Quotation and proposal procedures.
* Customer relationship management.
* Reporting and documentation requirements.

Confirmation of Employment

Upon successful and satisfactory completion of the **3-month probation period**, the employee may be confirmed in the position of **Sales & Marketing Executive**, subject to performance evaluation, management approval, and the company's employment policies.

Extension or Non-Confirmation

If the employee's performance, conduct, attendance, or achievement of assigned responsibilities is found to be unsatisfactory during the probation period, the company may extend the probation period or take appropriate action in accordance with the terms of employment, company policies, and applicable law.

Compensation

title: Product Mgr II
description:
**Product Mgr II**

**Are you passionate about shaping products that solve real customer problems and create meaningful business impact?**

**Do you enjoy collaborating with cross\-functional teams to bring innovative product features from concept to delivery?**

**About our Team**

RX Global aims to create unforgettable experiences for attendees and exhibitors through organizing events. Innovation, creativity, and collaboration drive the company to offer exceptional services to clients.


**About the Role**

The Product Manager II will own one or more product features and lead project execution. You will develop and manage product development plans, represent your feature area within a cross\-functional team, and drive solutions that address customer needs through a deep understanding of customer pain points. You will also prioritize customer issues and defects, support timely resolution, and demonstrate product progress and outcomes to key stakeholders.


**Responsibilities**

* Own one or more product features and drive product execution from concept through delivery.
* Develop and maintain product development plans aligned to customer needs and business objectives.
* Represent assigned features within cross\-functional teams and collaborate with engineering, design, and business stakeholders.
* Identify and propose new feature ideas that address customer pain points and opportunities.
* Prioritize customer issues and product defects using relevant data and customer insights.
* Support timely resolution of production issues and communicate priorities effectively.
* Lead product demonstrations for key stakeholders at program milestones.
* Contribute to the ongoing enhancement of digital and back\-office platforms supporting Sales, Marketing, and Finance functions.

**Requirements**

* Experience managing product features or products throughout the product lifecycle.
* Ability to translate customer needs into product requirements and feature enhancements.
* Strong stakeholder management and cross\-functional collaboration skills.
* Experience prioritizing work using customer feedback, data, and business objectives.
* Strong communication and presentation skills, including delivering product demonstrations.
* Analytical problem\-solving skills and a customer\-focused mindset.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.
* Strong collaboration skills with technical and non\-technical teams.

**Work in a Way That Works for You**

We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organization. We offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance, and sabbaticals, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and your long\-term goals.


**Working Pattern**

Working flexible hours \- flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive.


**Working for You**

We know that your wellbeing and happiness are key to a long and successful career. These are some of the benefits we are delighted to offer:


* Comprehensive Health Insurance: Covers you, your immediate family, and parents
* Enhanced Health Insurance Options: Competitive rates negotiated by the company
* Group Life Insurance: Ensuring financial security for your loved ones
* Group Accident Insurance: Extra protection for accidental death and permanent disablement
* Flexible Working Arrangement: Achieve a harmonious work\-life balance
* Employee Assistance Program: Access support for personal and work\-related challenges
* Medical Screening: Your well\-being is a top priority
* Modern Family Benefits: Maternity, paternity, and adoption support
* Long\-Service Awards: Recognizing dedication and commitment
* New Baby Gift: Celebrating the joy of parenthood
* Subsidized Meals in Chennai: Enjoy delicious meals at discounted rates
* Various Paid Time Off: Take time off with Casual Leave, Sick Leave, Privilege Leave, Compassionate Leave, Special Sick Leave, and Gazetted Public Holidays

**About the Business**

RX is a global leader in events and exhibitions, leveraging industry expertise, data, and technology to build businesses for individuals, communities, and organizations. With a presence in 25 countries across 41 industry sectors, RX hosts approximately 350 events annually. RX is committed to creating an inclusive work environment for all our people. description:
**About the Job**
-----------------


**Senior Executive \- Field Marketing (ERP Solutions)****Location:** **Chennai / Bangalore****Experience:** **4\-6 Years****Function:** **Marketing****Industry Preference:** **ERP / Enterprise Software / SaaS / B2B Technology****ERP Experience:** **Preferred but not Mandatory**
======================================================================================================================================================================================================================================================================================


**Job Summary**
---------------


We are seeking a dynamic and results\-oriented **Senior Executive \- Field Marketing** to drive demand generation, customer engagement, partner marketing initiatives, and regional marketing programs for our ERP and enterprise software solutions.


The ideal candidate will have experience executing B2B marketing campaigns, events, webinars, customer engagement programs, and lead generation initiatives that contribute directly to sales pipeline growth. Candidates with experience in ERP, SaaS, enterprise applications, or technology products will have an added advantage.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


### **Demand Generation \& Pipeline Creation**


* Plan and execute regional marketing campaigns to generate qualified leads and sales opportunities.
* Collaborate closely with sales teams to align marketing initiatives with revenue goals.
* Drive inbound and outbound demand generation programs across digital and offline channels.
* Monitor campaign performance and optimize activities to maximize ROI and pipeline contribution.

### **Events \& Customer Engagement**


* Organize and execute customer events, roundtables, executive briefings, roadshows, seminars, and industry conferences.
* Coordinate webinars, product launches, thought leadership programs, and solution showcase events.
* Manage event logistics including vendor management, venue coordination, marketing collateral, and attendee engagement.
* Develop post\-event nurture programs to convert attendees into qualified opportunities.

### **Partner \& Channel Marketing**


* Support channel partner marketing initiatives and co\-marketing campaigns.
* Work with partners to drive awareness, lead generation, and customer acquisition.
* Assist in developing partner marketing toolkits, campaign kits, and sales enablement assets.

### **Content \& Campaign Management**


* Collaborate with product marketing teams to create campaign messaging, case studies, customer success stories, and marketing collateral.
* Manage email campaigns, landing pages, social media promotions, and event communications.
* Ensure consistent brand messaging across all customer\-facing activities.

### **Analytics \& Reporting**


* Track campaign effectiveness using key marketing metrics.
* Measure lead generation, conversion rates, marketing\-qualified leads (MQLs), and pipeline contribution.
* Prepare regular reports and dashboards for sales and leadership teams.
* Utilize CRM and marketing automation platforms to manage campaign activities and reporting.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------


* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or related field.
* 4\-6 years of experience in Field Marketing, Demand Generation, Marketing Programs, Event Marketing, or Campaign Management.
* Experience supporting B2B technology, SaaS, ERP, Cloud, Enterprise Applications, or IT services organizations.
* Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to collaborate across sales, product, partner, and marketing teams.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and project management skills.
* Experience managing multiple campaigns and events simultaneously.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------


* Experience in ERP solutions such as SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, Infor, NetSuite, Epicor, Sage, or similar enterprise platforms.
* Knowledge of industries such as Manufacturing, BFSI, Retail, Distribution, Supply Chain, Healthcare, or Enterprise Services.
* Familiarity with CRM and marketing automation platforms such as Salesforce, HubSpot, Marketo, Zoho, or Microsoft Dynamics CRM.
* Experience managing regional marketing programs across India or international markets.

**Key Skills**
--------------


* Field Marketing
* Demand Generation
* Event Marketing
* B2B Marketing
* Campaign Management
* Lead Generation
* Webinar \& Customer Programs
* Partner Marketing
* Marketing Analytics
* CRM Management
* Stakeholder Management
* Budget Management

title: E-Commerce Manager
description:
About Lumibella Fashion

Lumibella Fashion has been serving customers with quality imitation and fashion jewellery since 2005\. We're looking for a hands\-on E\-commerce Manager to drive sales through our website and grow the brand's visibility across digital channels.

About the Role

We're hiring an **E\-commerce Manager** to take ownership of **lumibellafashion.co.in** from driving traffic to the site, to converting that traffic into sales, to keeping customers coming back. This is a hands\-on role for someone who can look at a website that isn't converting the way it should, figure out why, and fix it, while also running the day\-to\-day marketing that brings the right visitors in the door.

You'll work closely with the founder and have real input into the website experience, promotions, content, and marketing spend.

Core ResponsibilitiesWebsite Sales \& Conversion

* **Own website sales performance** — track daily/weekly numbers and be accountable for revenue generated through the site
* **Manage and improve the website** — homepage, product pages, cart, and checkout — to reduce drop\-off and improve the shopping experience
* **Improve conversion rate (CVR)** through better product photography, descriptions, pricing display, customer reviews, and a smoother checkout flow
* **Run A/B tests** on pricing, page layout, banners, and offers
* **Optimize for mobile**, since most jewellery shoppers browse and buy from their phones
* **Manage on\-site merchandising** — featured products, bundles, cross\-sells, and upsells
* **Set up and manage abandoned cart recovery, email/SMS flows, and retargeting** to recapture lost sales

Visibility \& Traffic Growth

* **Drive traffic to the website** through SEO, paid ads (Meta/Google/Instagram), influencer collaborations, and content
* **Manage performance marketing campaigns** — plan and run ad budgets across Meta, Google Shopping, and Instagram/Facebook
* **Grow organic visibility** — improve SEO (product titles, descriptions, blog content) and grow presence on Instagram, Facebook, and Pinterest in ways that funnel followers to the website
* **Coordinate influencer and partnership collaborations** to reach new customers
* **Manage marketplace listings** (Amazon, Myntra, Meesho, etc., if relevant) as an additional channel alongside the website

Reporting \& Retention

* **Track and report on performance** — traffic, conversion rate, average order value, and repeat purchase rate — using Google Analytics and website/ad platform dashboards
* **Run email/SMS marketing and loyalty offers** to increase repeat purchases
* **Coordinate with operations/fulfillment** to make sure growing demand doesn't create delivery or stock issues

What We're Looking For

* 2–4 years in e\-commerce, digital marketing, or online sales roles — ideally for a D2C, fashion, jewellery, or lifestyle brand
* Hands\-on experience managing a website/online store (Shopify or similar) and driving sales through it
* Working knowledge of Google Analytics, Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, basic SEO, and email/SMS marketing tools (e.g., Klaviyo, Mailchimp)
* Comfortable reading data and reports to guide day\-to\-day decisions
* Organized and self\-driven — able to manage multiple channels and priorities at once
* Good communication skills; able to work closely with the founder

Nice to Have

* Experience specifically in jewellery, accessories, or fashion e\-commerce
* Familiarity with the Indian D2C market and platforms like Shopify, Myntra, Meesho, or Amazon India
* Experience with influencer or affiliate marketing
* Basic design sense (Canva/Figma) for ad creative and website banners

Why Join Lumibella

* Direct access to and collaboration with the founder
* Room to grow into a larger leadership role as the business scales

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: ₹12,000\.00 \- ₹25,000\.00 per month

* Are you currently located in Chennai?

title: Sales & Marketing Manager
description:
Marketing Manager – Advaning Products

**Company:** Elite Screens India Pvt. Ltd.  
**Product Division:** Advaning – Awnings, Door Awnings, Canopies \& Related Outdoor Products  
**Location:** Coimbatore  
**Experience:** Minimum 5 years  
**Department:** Sales \& Marketing  
**Reports to:** Management

1\. Job Purpose

The Marketing Manager – Advaning Products will be responsible for developing and expanding the market for **Advaning awnings, door awnings, canopies and other related outdoor products** across India.

The position requires a proactive marketing professional who can identify new market opportunities, develop dealers and distributors, generate project enquiries, build relationships with architects, builders and contractors, and drive sales growth and brand awareness for Advaning.

2\. Key Responsibilities

**Market Development**

* Develop and implement marketing strategies for Advaning products across India.
* Identify new markets, customer segments and business opportunities.
* Study competitor products, pricing, distribution and market trends.
* Develop strategies to increase Advaning's market share and brand visibility.
* Identify potential applications for awnings in residential, commercial, hospitality and other projects.

**Dealer \& Distributor Development**

* Identify, appoint and develop dealers and distributors in key markets.
* Build strong relationships with dealers, distributors and channel partners.
* Support channel partners with product knowledge, quotations, marketing materials and sales support.
* Regularly monitor dealer performance and develop action plans for improving sales.
* Expand the Advaning dealer network across major cities and regional markets.

**Project \& Institutional Sales**

* Develop business opportunities with architects, interior designers, builders, contractors, hotels, resorts, commercial establishments and other institutional customers.
* Generate and follow up on project enquiries from initial enquiry through order closure.
* Conduct product presentations and demonstrations for potential customers.
* Coordinate with the technical and operations teams for project requirements and execution.

**Sales \& Marketing**

* Achieve monthly, quarterly and annual sales targets.
* Prepare and execute territory\-wise marketing plans.
* Conduct dealer visits, customer meetings, product presentations and market surveys.
* Develop promotional campaigns and local marketing activities.
* Generate leads through digital marketing, exhibitions, dealer networks and direct market development.
* Maintain a healthy sales pipeline and ensure timely follow\-up of all enquiries.

**Product \& Market Feedback**

* Collect regular feedback from dealers, customers and the market regarding products, pricing, quality and competition.
* Identify new product opportunities based on market requirements.
* Work closely with management to recommend product improvements, new sizes, designs and applications.
* Monitor competitor activities and report significant market developments to management.

**Reporting \& Management**

* Submit weekly and monthly sales and marketing reports.
* Maintain updated records of enquiries, leads, dealer visits, project opportunities and sales conversions.
* Prepare sales forecasts and market development plans.
* Monitor outstanding enquiries and ensure systematic follow\-up.
* Be accountable for achieving agreed sales and market\-development objectives.

3\. Qualification

* **Bachelor's Degree** in any relevant discipline.
* **MBA in Marketing – Desirable.**
* Minimum **5 years of relevant experience** in marketing and sales of:
* Door awnings
* Window awnings
* Retractable awnings
* Canopies
* Outdoor shading products
* Building products
* Architectural products
* Other related products

Candidates with experience in the **awning, façade, building\-materials, architectural\-products or outdoor\-living industry** will be preferred.

4\. Required Skills \& Competencies

* Excellent communication and presentation skills.
* **Fluent English and Hindi** communication is essential.
* Knowledge of **Tamil and/or other regional Indian languages** will be an advantage.
* Strong sales and negotiation skills.
* Good understanding of dealer and distributor management.
* Ability to independently develop new markets.
* Strong relationship\-building and networking skills.
* Ability to identify and convert new business opportunities.
* Good knowledge of MS Office, Excel and presentation tools.
* Willingness to travel extensively across India.
* Self\-motivated, target\-oriented and capable of working independently.
* Good commercial awareness and understanding of pricing and margins.

5\. Preferred Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate should be a **hands\-on marketing professional rather than purely an office\-based marketing executive**.

He should have:

* Proven experience in developing markets from scratch.
* Existing contacts with dealers, distributors, architects, builders or contractors.
* Experience in selling technical or architectural products.
* Ability to travel extensively and meet customers personally.
* Strong follow\-up discipline and ability to convert enquiries into orders.
* Ability to take ownership of the Advaning business and develop it into a significant revenue stream.

6\. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The performance of the Marketing Manager will be evaluated based on:

* Monthly and annual sales achievement.
* New dealer/distributor appointments.
* Active dealer productivity.
* Number and value of new project enquiries.
* Project conversion rate.
* New customer acquisition.
* Market expansion into new cities/regions.
* Enquiry\-to\-order conversion.
* Dealer and customer retention.
* Collection and payment discipline.
* Development and liquidation of existing inventory.
* Overall profitability and contribution of the Advaning division.

7\. Important Requirement

**This position involves extensive travel. The candidate must be willing to travel across India as required for dealer development, customer meetings, project visits, exhibitions and market development.**

Pay: ₹35,000\.00 \- ₹40,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Provident Fund
