description:
Job Title: State Head

Product: Unsecured Business Loans

Location: Chennai

Experience: 6–8 years

Industry: NBFC

Role Overview:

We are looking for an experienced and high\-energy State Head to lead and scale our NBFC sales

business for small ticket Unsecured Business Loans across the state.

The incumbent will be responsible for driving the overall business strategy, revenue, disbursement,

portfolio quality, and distribution expansion across Tamil Nadu. The role will involve managing a

strong sales team across major cities and emerging markets.

The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of the Tamil Nadu lending market, excellent

relationships within the NBFC/banking ecosystem, and a proven track record of building and scaling

unsecured business loan portfolios.

Key Responsibilities:

State Business Leadership

* Own the P\&L / business performance for the Unsecured Business Loan segment across

Tamil Nadu.

* Develop and execute the state\-level sales strategy in line with overall business objectives.
* Deliver monthly, quarterly, and annual targets for disbursement, AUM, revenue, and

customer acquisition.

* Identify high\-potential markets, customer segments, and new business opportunities across

Tamil Nadu.

* Develop a scalable channel acquisition strategy to increase business volumes.
* Ensure healthy sourcing volumes while maintaining credit quality and portfolio performance.
* Build long\-term strategic relationships with key partners and ensure strong market

positioning.

Team Management

* Lead, mentor, and manage the state sales team comprising Regional/Area Sales Managers,

Branch/Cluster Managers, Sales Managers, Relationship Managers, and Channel Managers.

* Define territory\-wise targets and ensure effective deployment of sales resources.
* Conduct regular performance reviews and develop action plans for underperforming

teams/markets.

* Recruit and retain high\-quality sales talent as the business expands.
* Build a performance\-driven and customer\-focused sales culture.
* Ensure field teams have adequate market coverage and partner engagement.

Business Growth \& Market Expansion

* Identify new geographies and customer segments suitable for unsecured business lending.
* Expand distribution through branches, direct sales and strategic partnerships.
* Analyse competitor offerings, pricing, credit policies, turnaround times, and market practices.
* Provide regular market intelligence and recommendations to the senior management team.
* Develop localized sales strategies based on the Tamil Nadu market and customer behaviour.

Credit \& Portfolio Quality

* Work closely with Credit, Risk, Operations, Collections, Product, and Finance teams to

ensure sustainable business growth.

* Maintain a strong balance between business growth, approval rates, and portfolio quality.
* Ensure sourcing teams understand product eligibility, credit policy, documentation, and

underwriting requirements.

* Monitor early delinquency and portfolio trends and take corrective action with relevant

teams.

* Ensure adherence to company policies, regulatory requirements, and ethical sales practices.

Core Competencies:

* Strong leadership and people\-management skills
* Excellent understanding of Tamil Nadu lending markets
* Proven ability to scale unsecured loan businesses
* Strong negotiation and relationship\-management skills
* Strong understanding of sales processes and funnel management
* High ownership, execution capability, and entrepreneurial mindset
* Excellent communication and presentation skills

Education:

* Graduate degree is mandatory.
* MBA / PGDM in Sales, Marketing, Finance, or Business Management will be preferred.

Experience:

* 6–8 years of overall experience in banking, NBFC or financial services.
* Minimum 2–4 years of experience managing a state / large sales function.
* Strong experience in Unsecured Business Loans / MSME Loans / Business Loans / SME

Lending will be preferred.

* Proven experience managing large sales teams and channel/DSA networks.
* Candidates with strong relationships across the Tamil Nadu NBFC / DSA ecosystem will

have an advantage.

Pay: ₹90,000\.00 \- ₹200,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: NPI Team Leader
description:
### **Job Description**


**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**



When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.


### **Job Purpose**



To lead a Business Unit wide multi\-functional team which manages all phases of the NSI (New Source Introduction) process for component\-sourcing projects.


**Job Duties:**



This position works with Engine Components \& Thermal Systems (ECTS) Engineering team, Platform Engineering, Customer Service, Purchasing, Operations, Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, Business Services, PMO, PSLD, Reman, and Suppliers to plan and execute critical sourcing projects for 3500, C175, 3600 \& Med Vee ECTS components.


### **Key responsibilities**


* Process Ownership of LPSD’s New Source Introduction (NSI) Workstream
* Possess expertise in all NSI disciplines; lead continuous improvement efforts
* Provide teaching and coaching for project leaders
* Maintain process guidance documentation (checklists, process flow map, templates, etc…)
* Provide and discuss Key Gateway Deliverables list
* Align project timelines with deliverables to determine gateway dates
* Provide and discuss gateway agenda template
* Provide and discuss DR/PR and Gateway examples
* Manage NSI Portfolio for ECTS Components
* Maintain NSI Project List of project ideas and active projects
* Meet weekly w/ Engineering Managers to update NSI Project List
* Track project performance by maintaining NSI Scorecard
* Present NSI Project List and NSI Scorecards to Product Manager in Monthly NSI Portfolio meeting
* Maintain NSI OBEYA charts and present to Product Manager in Monthly PM OBEYA meeting
* Lead NSI projects aligned with Large Engine Growth, Supplier resiliency and Assurance of supply initiatives
* Run Sourcing Council\-approved projects from GW L\-1 through GW 7
* Adhere to APQP discipline as the foundational process for executing all sourcing projects
* Utilize NSI Process Flow Map and Planning Template
* Schedule and lead weekly team meetings
* Meet key deliverables for each gateway
* Document and archive Applied Learning at GW 6 or GW 7


Typical major internal customers include employees from two or more work groups in a Division. External contacts include suppliers from whom Caterpillar procure material to produce engines. The incumbent sets priorities and establishes a work plan in order to complete broadly defined assignments and achieve desired results. Impacts key quality goals including Customer Satisfaction, Continuous Improvement, Timeliness, Accuracy, Efficiency, Cost Savings, Process Quality, etc. The position monitors adherence to quality standards and develops action plans for addressing below\-standard performance.


**Basic Qualifications:**


* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or related field with 10\&\#43; years of relevant experience engaged with cross\-functional or technical teams
* Excellent problem\-solving skills
* Strong leadership and team management capabilities
* Strong written and verbal communications skills with demonstrated ability to tailor communications to multiple levels of the organization.
* Top candidates will also have:
* Master’s degree in engineering or the sciences strongly preferred
* Strong understanding \& experience of the multiple functional disciplines that support component\-sourcing work, or direct work experience in at least one of these areas: Supply Chain, Procurement (Strategic and Tactical), Engineering, Product Management, Manufacturing, Quality, and Business Services roles.


**Skill Descriptors** Planning: Tactical, Strategic: Knowledge of effective planning techniques and ability to contribute to operational (short term), tactical (3\-5 years) and strategic (5\-7 years) planning in support of the overall business plan. Level Basic Understanding:


* Explains tactical plan for own area.
* Defines concepts of short\-term and long\-term planning.
* Describes the planning process and planning cycle used in own area.
* Compares tactical to strategic planning.
* Strong manufacturing process knowledge in key categories like Casting, Non metallics, Fabrications and on engine cooling components.


Products and Services: Knowledge of major products and services and product and service groups; ability to apply knowledge of product and service appropriately to diverse situations. Level Basic Understanding:


* Describes how own unit's products and services fit within the organization's as a whole.
* Cites examples of how clients are using the organization's products and services.
* Collects research product information, service information and marketing literature.
* Identifies organization's flagship products and services.


Quality Management: Knowledge of quality management methods, tools, and techniques and ability to create and support an environment that meets the quality goals of the organization. Level Basic Understanding:


* Explains the purpose and limitations of quality management.
* Accesses organizational resources that enable quality management.
* Defines quality management concepts.
* Cites examples of organizational quality management initiatives.


Effective Communications: Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviours. Level Basic Understanding:


* Describes non\-verbal behaviours that influence the interpretation of the message.
* Cites examples of effective and ineffective communications.
* Explains the importance of effective business communication.
* Speaks/writes using correct language, mechanics, and gestures.


Problem Solving: Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations. Level Basic Understanding:


* Explains the value of a disciplined approach to problem solving.
* Describes problem reporting and escalation practices.
* Utilizes accepted procedures for problem analysis and resolution.
* Identifies key aspects of problem\-solving techniques used in own area.


Customer Service Management: Knowledge of customer service priorities and ability to utilize tools and techniques for maintaining an environment where all understand, and are committed to providing excellent service to internal and external customers, process partners. Level Basic Understanding:


* Demonstrates an understanding of the underlying concepts and values of a service organization.
* Seeks help, as needed, in satisfying customers.
* Identifies key characteristics of effective customer service.
* Cites examples of keeping the customer as the focal point of all team activity.


Program / Project Management: Knowledge of the policies and techniques to manage a set of related projects within a program; ability to plan, organize, monitor, and control the set of projects, ensuring efficient utilization of technical and administrative resources to achieve program objectives. Level Working Knowledge:


* Assists in detailed project plans including cost, schedule, and resource requirements.
* Participates in planning, estimating, and executing a set of projects.
* Follows standard criteria to track project progress and status to ensure they are in line with program objectives.
* Monitors standard project status reports.
* Coordinates the necessary resources for managing efficient and effective projects within the program.


Design for Manufacturability (DFM): Knowledge of design for manufacturability guidelines, methodologies, and use cases; ability to use this knowledge to optimize product designs and manufacturing operations. Level Basic Understanding:


* Discusses the use cases, benefits, and importance of DFM.
* Explains the key DFM design principles.
* Lists the major tools and technologies used for implementing DFM methodologies.
* Locates the DFM guidelines for various types of manufacturing processes within the organization.


**Additional information:** This job requires 5 working days from office

description:
**JD FOR FARM MANAGER**

**Location:** Vellaputhur, Tamil Nadu  
**Experience:** 20 to 25 Years  
**Qualification:** Degree in Agriculture (Mandatory)  
**Employment Type:** Full\-time With Accommodation Language: English, Hindi \& Tamil (Mandatory )

**Farm Operations Management**: Overseeing day\-to\-day operations of the farm, including crop cultivation, livestock care, and maintenance of farm facilities.

1\. **Staff Management**: Hiring, training, scheduling, and supervising farm workers or labourer’s to ensure efficient operation of the farm.

2\. **Crop Planning and Management**: Developing crop rotation plans, selecting appropriate crops for planting, and managing planting, harvesting, and post\-harvest activities.

3\. **Livestock Care**: Ensuring the health and well\-being of livestock, including feeding, watering, monitoring for illness, and coordinating with veterinarians as needed.

4\. **Equipment Maintenance**: Maintaining farm equipment and machinery to ensure they are in good working condition. This includes scheduling regular maintenance and repairs as needed.

5\. **Budgeting and Financial Management**: Developing and managing the farm budget, including monitoring expenses, tracking revenues, and making financial decisions to ensure the profitability of the farm.

6\. **Marketing and Sales**: Identifying market opportunities for farm products, developing marketing strategies, and managing sales channels such as farmers' markets, CSA (Community Supported Agriculture) programs, or direct sales to restaurants and retailers.

7\. **Environmental Stewardship**: Implementing sustainable farming practices to minimize environmental impact, conserve natural resources, and promote soil health and biodiversity.

8\. **Compliance and Regulation**: Ensuring compliance with local, state, and federal regulations related to farming, food safety, labour, and environmental protection.

9\. **Record Keeping**: Maintaining accurate records of farm activities, including crop yields, livestock inventory, financial transactions, and regulatory compliance documentation.

10\. **Facility Management**: Managing farm buildings, infrastructure, and utilities to ensure they are well\-maintained and operational.

11\. **Pest and Disease Management**: Implementing integrated pest management strategies to control pests and diseases while minimizing the use of chemical pesticides.

12\. **Community Relations**: Building positive relationships with neighbours, community organizations, and local authorities to foster goodwill and address any concerns related to the farm's operations.

13\. **Emergency Response**: Developing and implementing emergency response plans to address situations such as severe weather, livestock emergencies, or equipment failures.

14\. **Continued Learning and Professional Development**: Staying informed about advancements in farming techniques, technologies, and regulations through on\-going education and professional development opportunities.

title: Medical Representative
description:
A **Medical Representative (MR)** is responsible for promoting and selling pharmaceutical products to healthcare professionals such as doctors, pharmacists, and hospitals. They act as a link between pharmaceutical companies and healthcare providers.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Visit doctors, hospitals, clinics, and pharmacies to promote pharmaceutical products.
* Explain product features, benefits, dosage, indications, and side effects to healthcare professionals.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with doctors, pharmacists, and other healthcare providers.
* Achieve monthly and annual sales targets.
* Organize product presentations, medical camps, and promotional activities.
* Monitor competitors' products and market trends.
* Collect customer feedback and report market information to management.
* Maintain records of daily visits, sales, and expenses.
* Ensure compliance with company policies and ethical marketing practices.

**Required Skills:**

* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Good knowledge of pharmaceutical products and medical terminology.
* Sales and negotiation skills.
* Time management and organizational abilities.
* Problem\-solving and customer service skills.
* Ability to travel frequently.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Pharmacy, Life Sciences, Nursing, or a related field (requirements vary by employer).
* Previous sales experience is an advantage but not always required.
* Valid driver's license (if field travel is required).

**Work Environment:**

* Primarily field\-based, involving regular travel to healthcare facilities.
* May require working flexible hours to meet healthcare professionals.

**Career Growth:**  
A Medical Representative can progress to roles such as:

* Senior Medical Representative
* Area Sales Manager
* Regional Sales Manager
* Product Manager
* National Sales Manager
